Survey and image suppliers perform acquisition; their existing capture is not claimed as a saving. s1 counts the cartographer's source receipt, inspection and reference-system verification. Missing control or uncertain reference systems require manual resolution before s2.

s2 replaces repeated manual project assembly, not unattended image processing time. Existing reprojection, rendering and mosaic computation remain baseline. s4 saves only repeated production-setting handling; it retains actual product preparation.
The task ends at the saved internal product. No hidden distribution, production database replacement or external publication is authorized. Same-system saving is negligible with no saving.
If project staging also serves task 3523, count the same transfer once. Gross 29.5 minus 4 upkeep gives 25.5 net per 100 focal baseline hours.

tasks.design: Configure the existing {OPS_SYSTEM} GIS and {DATA_PLATFORM} database to stage exact source mappings and check declared constraints. The cartographer resolves conflicts and checks the complete final change set before committing its exact version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual record mapping and repeated database comparisons add effort to legitimate geographic decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native import profiles, staged transactions and declared constraints can replace repeated manual handling.
tasks.still_hard: A valid schema does not establish that geographic facts are correct or that conflicting sources describe the same feature.
tasks.human_edge: The cartographer decides which source changes accurately represent the mapped world.

ambition.what: Refresh accepted geographic records more frequently.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 for database ownership and source access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: geographic databases support explicit import mappings, schema checks and staged transactions without an autonomous agent.

assumptions: Unmeasured database build/update episode with actual manual staging and constraint comparisons, not a universal baseline. Shares are independent of the prompt prior.

Authorized source owners capture source records; s1 counts receipt, source verification and actual change specification. Unmatched identifiers and conflicting facts remain manual in s4, with no inferred updates.

s2 and s3 are explicit separate proposed machine actions. Existing import jobs, indexes, constraints and unattended database runtime are baseline; equivalent current automation earns no additional saving.

s4 includes the actual complete final change review and restoration reference. If sources, change set or database version change, the commit gate is invalidated. Commit time is effectively immediate and earns no saving.
No external publication, permission grant or notification is bundled into the commit. Transfers already counted in map revision or source assembly are not counted twice for the same episode.
Gross 55 minus 5 incremental upkeep gives 50 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
unknowns: Current manual mapping and validation effort

tasks.design: Reuse native {OPS_SYSTEM} project fields to document the actual map specification in {DOCS}. Keep content, layout and projection decisions, final specification checking and production direction with the cartographer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly recording chosen project settings can duplicate information already in the design workstation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing project fields and specification templates can carry the chosen settings into the actual working specification.
tasks.still_hard: Purpose, source limitations, legibility and production tradeoffs remain design judgments.
tasks.human_edge: The cartographer chooses what the map should communicate and checks actual production quality.

ambition.what: Make existing specification recording slightly easier.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: cartographic project fields and document templates can reuse actual chosen production settings.

assumptions: Unmeasured specification-and-direction episode, independently sized from actual work rather than the prompt prior.
The requester supplies the actual brief; s1 counts clarification. s2 performs actual design choices; no free complete specification is assumed.

s3 includes the actual specification record and its complete final check. Native fields save repeated setting transcription only; equivalent existing templates earn no new saving. The same-system save is effectively immediate and has no saving.

s5 covers actual production direction and inspection without inventing a separate report after each conversation. No external distribution, procurement or production release is hidden in the save. A changed specification must be checked again before saving.
Gross 3 minus 1 incremental template upkeep gives 2 net per 100 focal baseline hours. Actual map corrections or database changes belong to their own tasks and are not counted here.
